scope: Full static review of archive settings, retention policy response parser, budget panel and budget parser; not real backend or full frontend acceptance
notes: Exploration can omit archive choice/budget; formal requirements remain runtime-enforced against original run snapshot.
External backend selection requires a shared name, with access location kept in private configuration.
Budget input constraints are advisory UI validation; backend rejects invalid values rather than trusting HTML constraints.
Budget parser preserves unknown totals, rejects remote-usage claims, checks candidate scope and verifies consistent derived totals/status.
Requests clear old reports and are generation-bound; report never executes deletion or paid-storage changes.
